name: Colorado River (Grand Canyon)
gaugeName: Colorado River at Lees Ferry, AZ
blurb: Grand Canyon from Lees Ferry: multi-week whitewater trips. NPS permit required (weighted lottery for noncommercial trips); Diamond Creek take-out crosses Hualapai land.

sections.notes: NPS: Diamond Creek is river mile 225. NPS permit required (noncommercial weighted lottery). Hualapai Tribe charges separate fees to take out at Diamond Creek. Gauge at Lees Ferry is at the start; tributary inflow changes flow downstream.
sections.routeReview: Diamond Creek is an approximate, permit-required access area on Hualapai land. This access map does not show an exact landing connection, road route, or reviewed river course.

notices.title: Diamond Creek: arrange permits in advance
notices.text: Diamond Creek is on Hualapai land. Arrange tribal permits and fees for people, boats and vehicles before the trip, as well as the required NPS river permit. Check Diamond Creek Road conditions with the Tribe; the unpaved road is vulnerable to washouts. The map marker locates the access area, not an exact shoreline ramp.
notices.sourceName: National Park Service — Diamond Creek trip and permit guidance

sections.notes: NPS: 'the entire stretch to river mile 277 (Pearce Ferry) is free-flowing whitewater'; NPS regulations describe the river between 'river mile 0 at Lees Ferry and river mile 279 near Pearce Ferry'. Mileage uses 277 from the Diamond Creek page. Take out at Pearce Ferry or South Cove (NPS); the Pearce Ferry ramp is for Grand Canyon river-trip take-outs only (no launching). NPS permit required.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
